name: AWeber
description: AWeber is an email marketing platform for subscribers, lists, broadcasts, followup campaigns, landing pages, forms, and audience automation. Organizations use it to manage email audiences and campaigns.
agentUseSummary: Connect one AWeber account through Relay's confidential OAuth app with PKCE, refresh tokens, and only account.read, list.read, subscriber.read, and email.read. Relay binds one account, list, numeric subscriber, and broadcast or followup campaign, then exposes only the subscriber ID and subscription time plus bounded campaign metadata; personal data, content, statistics, broader access, automation, exports, and mutations are blocked.

capabilities.label: Read selected subscriber summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and subscription time for one selected subscriber without identity, contact, consent, status, activity, IP, location, tag, or custom fields.

capabilities.label: Read selected campaign summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded organizational metadata for one selected broadcast or followup campaign.

allowed.label: Read selected subscriber summary
allowed.description: Read the selected subscriber's ID and subscription time while discarding all personal, preference, status, and engagement fields.

allowed.label: Read selected campaign summary
allowed.description: Read the selected broadcast or followup campaign's ID, type, status, and timestamps while discarding subject, content, sender, recipient, link, and statistics fields.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Subscriber identity, contact, consent, status, activity, IP, location, tags, and custom fields plus campaign subject, content, sender, recipients, links, and statistics are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate AWeber state
blocked.description: Subscriber changes, tags, custom fields, lists, broadcasts, followups, sends, webhooks, integrations, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad AWeber access
blocked.description: Other accounts, lists, subscribers, campaigns, messages, collections, searches, pages, arbitrary paths, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected subscriber and campaign through an account-and-list-bound Relay OAuth grant; private data, broader access, and mutations remain blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: An AWeber confidential OAuth app, exact Railway callback, provider-issued client credentials, authorized staging account and list, numeric subscriber ID, broadcast or followup campaign type and ID, and live grant are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console lane must register Relay's confidential AWeber OAuth app with the exact Railway callback and four required read scopes, capture its client credentials in Railway, authorize a staging account, bind the numeric account, list, subscriber, campaign type, and campaign IDs, then validate account/list isolation, both redacted reads, campaign-type denial, authorization and rate errors, refresh rotation, revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: AWeber documents OAuth 2 authorization-code grants at auth.aweber.com, confidential clients, PKCE, expiring access tokens, refresh tokens, and account.read, list.read, subscriber.read, and email.read scopes.
AWeber documents GET /1.0/accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/subscribers/{subscriberId} and the personal, activity, IP, location, tag, and custom fields excluded by Relay.

AWeber documents GET /1.0/accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/campaigns/{campaignType}{campaignId}, where b selects broadcasts and f selects followups; broader Campaigns automation is not API-supported.
AWeber documents safe 400, 401, 403, 404, 410, 500, and 503 response semantics used by Relay's bounded error mapping.
